your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Early game, one light blue (Oriental). p1 has Connecticut, Vermont still unowned. No useful trade yet and no reason to mortgage. Keep $1400 liquid for railroads, oranges, and Vermont if it lands. End turn.

Bought St. James for $180. Cash left $1220. Own Oriental (light blue) and now one orange. p1 owns Tennessee, so orange monopoly needs a trade or New York. Don't auction a core orange I can afford. Keep cash for New York, Vermont, and railroads.

Just bought St. James. Own Oriental + one orange. No monopoly, nothing to build, no reason to mortgage with $1220. p1 holds Connecticut and Tennessee, so both my sets need a later trade plus an unowned third (Vermont, New York). Don't overpay now. End turn and stay liquid for NY, Vermont, railroads.

Reject the $60-over-cost orange grab. p1 already has Tennessee; selling St. James gives them 2/3 of the best set. Counter for Connecticut instead: dead to them, gives me 2/3 light blue while I still block oranges and keep $980. Anchor at 2x cost; can go up later if needed, but don't pay monopoly prices or include St. James.

Reject. Swap is -$40 face and hands p1 2/3 oranges (best set) while I only get 2/3 cheap light blues. Vermont and NY still unowned. Keep St. James as orange blocker. Only reopen if they sell Connecticut for cash without taking St. James.

Bought Atlantic for $260. Cash left $960. Own Oriental, St. James, and now one yellow (0/3). Yellows are a premium set and all three are still open, so don't auction and let p1/p2/p3 grab a foothold cheap. Stay liquid for Ventnor, Marvin, New York, Vermont, and railroads. No monopoly yet; don't build or mortgage.

Just bought Atlantic. Own Oriental, St. James, Atlantic. No monopoly, nothing to build, $960 liquid. Do not mortgage. Do not trade St. James to p1 (they already hold Tennessee) or sell Atlantic. Yellows are the cleanest path: Ventnor and Marvin still unowned. Also watch NY, Vermont, railroads. End turn.

p2 owns Boardwalk. Park Place is the instant dark-blue monopoly — do not auction. $350 is list and I can afford it ($960 → $610). A stranded Park Place is a blocker and a future trade chip against p2; an auction risks p2 completing the set and building. Yellows still need Marvin (unowned) plus a deal with p3 for Ventnor. Keep St. James; do not sell it to p1. Stay liquid after this buy.

No monopoly, nothing to build, no reason to mortgage at $610. Do not sell Park Place to p2 (instant dark-blue set) or St. James to p1 (2/3 oranges). Ventnor from p3 is premature: still need Marvin ($280) and a cash deal would leave me unable to finish yellows. Connecticut cash-only already refused. Keep blockers: Oriental vs p1 light blue, St. James vs p1 orange, Atlantic vs p3 yellow, Park Place vs p2 Boardwalk. Next buys: Marvin, NY, Vermont, railroads. End turn.

Buy Ventnor before Marvin so p3 can't charge monopoly prices later. $320 is ~23% over $260. Cash left $486, enough for Marvin ($280) plus ~$206 buffer. Do not include Atlantic, St. James, or Park Place. If rejected, raise toward ~$400 max — not so high I can't buy Marvin and survive rents. No deals with p1/p2 that hand them a set.
